description: Recurring picture, 1400x420: three big flat ink icons in a row on the cream page (centres x 233/700/1167): closed envelope (#icon-letter, fill #fill-letter), folded Inland Letter Card with three flaps (#icon-ilc, #fill-ilc), open postcard with printed stamp (#icon-postcard, #fill-postcard). Fills white; the taught one is coloured #f3ead6 by the scene, the others go warm grey #6f6a63. 3 px ink outlines.

Inland Letter Card unfolded, 900x600: sand #f3ead6 sheet, ink outline, two dashed fold lines, three flaps (#flap-left, #flap-right, #flap-top) with gum bands, printed stamp (#ilc-stamp), blank address rules (#ilc-rules), blank title spot top left of the address panel (#ilc-title-spot). No lettering.

Inland Letter Card folded shut, 630x300 (210x100 mm), address side up, three flap edges visible, printed stamp top right (#ilc-stamp), blank title spot top left (#ilc-title-spot), address rules. No lettering.
Rolled document tied with string, 800x200, side view with elliptical round end at right (#roll-end) and body (#roll-body), sand paper, ink outline.
Flat ink letter scale 500x420: sand body, round dial with needle (#needle), flat pan on top.
Corner-lifted paper sheet 360x460 with a visible thickness edge (#edge), white, ink outline.
Metal paper clip (#clip) and a staple (#staple) side by side, 320x200, slate ink.
Flat sealed packet 640x400 holding a film-reel shape, sand wrap, blank white label (#film-label, x120-520 y120-280) for the scene to letter.
Plain ink 1D barcode bars on white, 420x120, no digits.
Generic spreadsheet file icon 320x380: green corner fold, grid of cells, no brand logo.
Three ink icons on one ground line, 1200x300: train (#rail), road van (#road), plane (#air).
Blue (#2456a6) rectangular airmail label 360x160 with white border, blank for lettering 'AIR MAIL'.
White label 640x200 with blue border, blank for lettering 'For Limited air lifts between … and … only'.
Red pillar letter box 360x600 with two bright yellow #f2b705 bands round it and a blank plate; ink outline.
Small sealed box 360x300 with a vial shape on its label panel, ink outline, sand and white.
